patch.summary:
Choose Fly.io only if your buying job matches “Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regio” rather than ThorData's shape. Choose ThorData only if your buying job matches “Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit” rather than Fly.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Fly.io leans cloud-paas; ThorData leans web-data-collection. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Fly.io is Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regions. Support Standard $29/mo is support, not hostin; ThorData is Budget proxy + scraper tooling — Residential from $2/GB (1GB pack); Web Scraper API credit packs from ~$30..
- Company-size focus: Fly.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs ThorData (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Fly.io-leaning cloud-paas vs ThorData-leaning web-data-collection.
- Researched limits: Fly.io — Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award; ThorData — Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs.

Limitations — Fly.io: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award; Support Standard $29/mo is support — not the hosting floor; ThorData: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs; Marketing claims should be validated — score from published packaging, not Fortune-500 slogans.
